B2-R01 is actionable: explicit HTTP 401 does not reach account reauthentication. Source path: DeckApi.kt:75-77 maps 401; DeckLibraryController.kt:73-80 and DeckImportController.kt:88-92 only display deckError; AuthViewModel.kt:30-49 has no invalidation handoff. AuthController.submit/page refuse entry while account is present, AccountEntry keeps rendering AuthenticatedShell, and MainActivity.onResume syncs decks without reauth. A real DeckApi/MockEngine 401 coupled with production auth/library controllers prints account/token still present and fails the required sign-in outcome. No native reproduction or repair is claimed. Ordinary transport/catalog/art failures otherwise retain usable work under reviewed branches and retained actual journeys. No speculative race, style issue or stronger reset/in-flight guarantee was promoted to a blocker.
